2026_02_IND_KC.headline: Indianapolis tests its repaired defensive communication against Kansas City’s balance
2026_02_IND_KC.paragraph1: Indianapolis spent the week correcting alignment and communication after surrendering 41 points to Baltimore, and Kansas City presents another demanding assignment because its offense is willing to lean on the run as well as Patrick Mahomes. The Chiefs will be without left tackle Josh Simmons and safety Chamarri Conner, while Chris Jones is questionable. The Colts need cleaner pre-snap organization and disciplined fits; Kansas City must protect its edges and avoid giving Indianapolis short-field opportunities.
2026_02_IND_KC.model_rationale: Indianapolis must prove its defensive communication fixes hold against Kansas City’s varied run-pass structure, while the Chiefs’ altered protection plan creates an opening for disruptive pressure.
